text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O comes to me asking for a "meager favor" a few days before the holidays.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, would you arrange a small holiday party for me?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I would need you to gather royalty from around the world, of course!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What? Are you burdened with other responsibilities? Then I shall lower my standards slightly…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: How about gathering the most influential people you can? So long as you put in the effort, I'll be satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's never really a choice with her, so I accept. I just hope she doesn't wind up stepping on too many toes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, on the big day…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I see. That venue has your company's sponsorship. Just wonderful.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Gifting a cape customized for me?! This is an honor!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Opera O manages to turn her usual behavior down a notch in front of the guests.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After our lively party comes to a close…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You have my thanks, Trainer. That was time very well spent.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: As a result, I was able to make the guests familiar with what kind of Umamusume I, T.M. Opera O, truly am.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm? A plot, you say?
choice_data_list: You weren't acting like your usual self.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ohh, because I was somewhat quiet?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, I was indeed holding back. After all, had I unleashed my full voice…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My sheer nobleness would have left them petrified. I do not wish to create such casualties.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I need humanity to adjust little by little to the soon-to-be-born brilliance of the Centurial Overlord.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Opera O raises her hands to the night sky and begins weaving her epic tale.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: At this moment, the species known as humankind, in its eternal leading role, dances atop the stage we call Earth.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: They believe their position to be infallible. However…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The overwhelmingly powerful and beautiful Centurial Overlord is on the cusp of birth. The peerless Umamusume that is I.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What would befall those influential individuals if they were to behold me without prior preparation?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Surely, ninety-nine percent of them would become devout worshippers. But the remaining one percent would be so overwhelmed, they would be…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Precisely so. I must prove that I mean them no harm beforehand, lest their awe turn to terror.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do not misunderstand. My quiet demeanor was meant to have appeal.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I have confidence the appropriate amount of my excellence came across to each guest at today's party.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now that one hundred percent of them will become my believers, senseless conflict can be avoided.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And that is a great deal of weight off my shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It turns out the holiday party I thought was just a lark had a lot more meaning to Opera O.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I pray that today's guests will become my walle—my biggest fans.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And I pray that they will see me as a top athlete and sponsor my efforts.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Also! I pray that they will build theme parks dedicated to me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: T.M. Operaland! T.M. Opera Gardens! And Opera O Studios Japan, as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …So much for being levelheaded.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now then, Trainer. You know what you must do, yes?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You must bring me more persons of influence. Their connections will be indispensable in getting my worldwide amusement park plan off the ground.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And bring actual royalty to next year's party!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No complaints or excuses. It is your duty to walk this shining path at my side.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Quite the demanding festive gift… Opera O laughs as she assigns me this nearly impossible task.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: If you know not, then follow me. A short initiation is in order.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Opera O brings me to…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Listen well, Trainer. I took the roundabout route today so you could ease into understanding me…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But there is a more direct way—a bold and overlordly way.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! That is… to bring out the most influential version of yourself.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: In other words, you must become the ruler of humanity!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You already possess the necessary ability. Just look at my sheer number of fans!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Due to your efforts, I have acquired many devoted followers!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: If a ruler of humanity with your skills were to unite with the Centurial Overlord of Umamusume, the world would finally know peace, would it not?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You know every bit of my person, my brilliance. If you were to become humanity's representative—why, there shouldn't even be need for discussion.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: After all… Even the Overlord needs a partner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Opera O smiles at me gently.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is the physical embodiment of my promise. Would you accept this ring?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The promise ring I have kept warm and near my heart for so long.
choice_data_list: Exactly what kind of ring is that?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh… It could be referred to, I suppose, as the proof of engagement between two species.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It is the Ring of the Nibelung!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: With its magical power, you can seize the will of humankind—and take over the world!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hah ha ha! Now, laugh with me! Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I laugh, though I don't really know what she's on about. Either way, I'll remember this holiday season as the one when Opera O introduced me to a brand new world.
